summary: Iteration 34 - SEBI Compliance Layer Testing: All 19 backend tests passed. Frontend Admin Compliance Dashboard verified working with all components. MongoDB audit_trail collection confirmed NO TTL index (SEBI 5-year retention compliant).

issues: Minor React hydration warning: <tr> cannot be child of <span> in audit trail table - cosmetic only, doesn't affect functionality

passed_tests: GET /api/v1/compliance/status returns 200 (public, no auth)
Compliance status has all required SEBI fields (framework, circular, audit_trail, data_retention, etc.)
POST /api/v1/auth/login creates user_login audit entry
POST /api/v1/auth/register creates user_registered audit entry
POST /api/v1/auth/logout creates user_logout audit entry
GET /api/v1/admin/compliance/audit-stats returns total_entries, entries_today, retention_years=5
GET /api/v1/admin/compliance/audit-trail returns paginated entries with filters (action, user_id)
GET /api/v1/admin/compliance/audit-export returns CSV file with correct headers
GET /api/v1/admin/compliance/ops returns threshold=10 and users array
GET /api/v1/admin/compliance/strategy-classification returns white_box and black_box counts
POST /api/v1/strategy/{id}/execute-live returns 403 with algo-id registration message
Strategy model has algo_id, algo_registered, classification fields
All admin compliance endpoints require authentication (return 401/403 without auth)
audit_trail collection has NO TTL index (verified via MongoDB)
Admin Compliance Dashboard page loads at /admin/compliance
SEBI Compliance Status card displays all fields
Audit stats cards show total entries, today, this month, retention
OPS Monitoring card shows threshold and active users
Strategy Classification card shows white_box/black_box breakdown
Audit Trail table with filters (action, user_id, date range)
Export CSV button present and functional
Compliance nav item visible in Admin sidebar
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: AdminCompliance.js has React hydration warning due to dynamic content rendering in table - consider wrapping map() output differently to avoid <span> wrapper inside <tbody>
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 34 tested SEBI compliance layer. All 9 tasks verified: (1) Immutable audit trail with NO TTL index, (2) Audit logging on auth events (register, login, logout), (3) Algo-ID gate blocks live execution with 403, (4) Public compliance status endpoint, (5) OPS monitoring framework, (6) Strategy classification (white_box/black_box), (7) Admin compliance dashboard with all cards and filters, (8) CSV export working, (9) Strategy model has SEBI fields. The audit_trail collection has 16+ entries from testing. All admin endpoints require auth.
